literal: Desire not, even if one wins, gambling; even that which was won is like a fish having swallowed the hook's metal.
translation: Do not desire gambling even if you can win. Even what is won is like a fish swallowing the metal hook.
modern: சூதாட்டத்தில் வெற்றி பெற்றாலும் அதனை விரும்பக் கூடாது. அதில் வென்ற பொருளும், மீன் தூண்டிலின் இரும்பை இரை என்று நினைத்து விழுங்குவதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: The couplet warns against the deceptive nature of gambling. It advises never to desire gambling, even if one happens to win initially. The word 'பொன்' here refers to the metal of the fishing hook, not gold. Just as a fish swallows the hook thinking it is food and gets caught, the initial winnings in gambling trap the gambler into ultimate ruin.
